items.title: OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway
items.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation has released v2026.8.1, which the project calls OpenClaw 2.0: 933 contributors, 569 first-timers, and more than 16,000 pull requests, roughly half of every PR ever merged into the repo. Setup now reuses existing subscriptions, API keys and local models. The rebuilt Control UI cut test-harness startup from about 1.6 seconds to 575 ms. Shared cloud sessions add real multiplayer, though the docs are explicit that they are not a security boundary. The post OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: OpenClaw 基金會發布了 v2026.8.1 版本，專案稱為 OpenClaw 2.0：總共有 933 位貢獻者，其中 569 位是首次參與，並且收到了超過 16,000 個拉取請求，約佔所有合併到程式碼庫中的拉取請求總數的一半。新版本在設定過程中可以重複使用現有的訂閱、API 金鑰和本機模型。重新建構的控制介面將測試框架的啟動時間從約 1.6 秒縮短至 575 毫秒。共享雲端會話增加了真正的多人遊戲功能，但文件明確指出它們並非安全邊界。這篇文章《OpenClaw 發布 OpenClaw 2.0：引導式模型設定、575 毫秒控制介面啟動以及每個網關一個信任邊界》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark
items.summary: Voice agents fail on latency long before they fail on intelligence. Time to first token is the metric most teams use to choose an inference API, and it is the right starting point and the wrong stopping point. This benchmark works through every layer of the voice stack — LLM, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and speech-to-speech — using figures verified against primary sources on August 30, 2026, with each number labeled as independently measured, vendor-published, or vendor-measured on its own product. The post Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 語音代理的延遲問題遠早於其智慧水準的問題。首次令牌處理時間 (TTFT) 是大多數團隊選擇推理 API 時使用的指標，它雖然是正確的起點，但卻是錯誤的終點。此基準測試涵蓋了語音協定堆疊的每一層——LLM、語音轉文字、文字轉語音和語音轉語音——並使用截至 2026 年 8 月 30 日經原始資料來源驗證的數據，每個數據都標註為獨立測量、廠商發布或廠商在其自身產品上測量。本文《語音和即時代理的最低延遲推理 API：首次令牌處理時間 (TTFT) 基準測試》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Google AI Introduces EnvHarness: A Programmable Layer That Turns Static Agent Environments Into Adaptive Training Worlds
items.summary: Google Cloud AI Research, with Washington University in St. Louis and UNC Chapel Hill, has released EnvHarness, an Apache-2.0 layer that turns a static agent benchmark into one that adapts to the policy training on it. It wraps a frozen environment through the standard reset()/step() interface, so tasks and human-built verifiers stay untouched — and an LLM designer, EnvRigger, writes those wrappers automatically against flaws diagnosed in the agent's own rollouts. Across five benchmarks, mined skills gain up to 9.0 points on held-out tasks with 9.8% fewer execution steps. The post Google AI Introduces EnvHarness: A Programmable Layer That Turns Static Agent Environments Into Adaptive Training Worlds appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Google 雲端人工智慧研究中心與聖路易斯華盛頓大學和北卡羅來納大學教堂山分校合作，發布了 EnvHarness，這是一個 Apache 2.0 層，可以將靜態智能體基準測試轉換為能夠適應其策略訓練的自適應環境。它透過標準的 reset()/step() 介面封裝了一個凍結的環境，因此任務和人工建置的驗證器保持不變——LLM 的設計者 EnvRigger 會針對智能體自身部署中發現的缺陷自動編寫這些封裝器。在五個基準測試中，挖掘出的技能在保留的任務上最多可獲得 9.0 分的提升，同時執行步驟減少了 9.8%。這篇文章《Google AI 推出 EnvHarness：將靜態智能體環境轉化為自適應訓練環境的可程式層》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: AI sentiment is turning sour as employee reviews reveal growing frustration across the workforce
items.summary: An analysis of Glassdoor reviews shows that positive AI comments have dropped from 81 to 43 percent since 2019. Executives rate AI mostly positive, while insurance claims workers rate it almost entirely negative. Fear of job loss is just one complaint among many. Forced adoption, surveillance, and unrealistic productivity expectations weigh just as heavily. The article AI sentiment is turning sour as employee reviews reveal growing frustration across the workforce appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Glassdoor 評論分析顯示，自 2019 年以來，對人工智慧 (AI) 的正面評價已從 81% 下降至 43%。高階主管對 AI 的評價大多為正面，而保險理賠員幾乎全部持負面態度。對失業的擔憂只是眾多抱怨之一。強制採用、監控以及不切實際的生產力預期同樣令人擔憂。這篇文章《員工評論揭示員工日益增長的不滿情緒，AI 輿論風向正在轉變》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: AI agents have no sense of time and are not aware of it
items.summary: AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Codex have no sense of time, according to a new study. Both systematically overestimate how long tasks will take. Codex is off by as much as ten times the actual duration. They also rate their own work about 20 percentage points too high. For long, autonomous tasks, that creates a real problem with oversight. The article AI agents have no sense of time and are not aware of it appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 一項新研究表明，像 Claude Code 和 Codex 這樣的 AI 編碼助手缺乏時間觀念。它們都會系統性地高估任務所需時間。 Codex 的估計時間甚至高達實際時間的十倍。此外，它們對自己工作的評分也偏高約 20 個百分點。對於耗時較長的自主任務而言，這會造成嚴重的監管問題。本文《AI 代理沒有時間觀念，也無法感知時間》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: The skills that earn top grades are the ones AI can fake best
items.summary: GPT-4o boosted grades on a marketing assignment by nearly a full point on a five-point scale in an experiment with 1,053 Bocconi University students. The article The skills that earn top grades are the ones AI can fake best appeared first on The Decoder .

items.summary: Sony Music, Warner Music, and other publishers are suing Anthropic and CEO Dario Amodei personally for allegedly using tens of thousands of copyrighted musical compositions to train Claude without permission. items.title: Understanding ChatGPT Work
items.summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product. Here's what I've figured out about it so far. ChatGPT Work is actually two products The more interesting version of ChatGPT Work is the one that runs in the cloud. This can be accessed via chatgpt.com or through the ChatGPT mobile apps. Let's call it Work Cloud . If you install the ChatGPT desktop app - the app that used to be called Codex - you gain access to a thing called ChatGPT Work that can access files and run programs directly on your computer. Let's call that one Work Local . This one feels more like regular Codex re-skinned to be less intimidating to non-software-developers. For the rest of this article I'm going to talk exclusively about Work Cloud. Work is for paid subscribers only Right now, ChatGPT Work (in both flavors) is available only to $20/month and up subscribers. Free users and $8/month Go users do not have access. Work has features that aren't available in Chat The interface for accessing Work is a tab selector, which presents it as an alternative to Chat: The obvious question is when should I use Chat, and when should I use Work? OpenAI's official answer to that question is: Use Chat when you want an answer, explanation, brainstorm, or short draft. Use ChatGPT Work when you want ChatGPT to complete a task with a clear outcome, such as a brief, deck, analysis, recurring update, workflow, or file you can review and use. I find that almost entirely useless, because I've been using regular ChatGPT Ch
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 7 月 9 日發布了 ChatGPT Work，此後一直在對其進行快速迭代。這是一款極其複雜但功能強大的產品。以下是我目前對它的一些瞭解。 ChatGPT Work 實際上包含兩個產品。 ChatGPT Work 中更有趣的版本是雲端版本。使用者可以透過 chatgpt.com 或 ChatGPT 行動應用程式存取此版本。我們稱之為 Work Cloud。如果您安裝了 ChatGPT 桌面應用程式（以前稱為 Codex），則可以存取名為 ChatGPT Work 的產品，該產品可以直接存取電腦上的檔案並執行程式。我們稱之為 Work Local。這款產品感覺更像是重新包裝的 Codex，旨在降低非軟體開發人員的接受度。本文的其餘部分將專門討論 Work Cloud。目前，Work 功能僅限付費使用者使用。 ChatGPT Work（包括兩種版本）僅對每月 20 美元及以上的訂閱使用者開放。免費使用者和每月 8 美元的 Go 使用者無法使用。 Work 擁有 Chat 所不具備的功能。 Work 的介面是一個標籤選擇器，它被視為 Chat 的替代方案：顯而易見的問題是，我應該何時使用 Chat，何時使用 Work？ OpenAI's 對此問題的正式回答是：當您需要答案、解釋、腦力激盪或簡短草稿時，請使用 Chat。當您需要 ChatGPT 完成一項具有明確結果的任務時，例如撰寫簡報、簡報、分析報告、定期更新、工作流程或可供您審查和使用的檔案，請使用 ChatGPT Work。我發現這幾乎完全沒用，因為我一直在使用常規的 ChatGPT Ch。

items_ai.title: OpenClaw Releases OpenClaw 2.0: Guided Model Setup, 575 ms Control UI Startup, and One Trust Boundary Per Gateway
items_ai.summary: The OpenClaw Foundation has released v2026.8.1, which the project calls OpenClaw 2.0: 933 contributors, 569 first-timers, and more than 16,000 pull requests, roughly half of every PR ever merged into the repo. Setup now reuses existing subscriptions, API keys and local models. The rebuilt Control UI cut test-harness startup from about 1.6 seconds to 575 ms. items_ai.title: Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark
items_ai.summary: Voice agents fail on latency long before they fail on intelligence. Time to first token is the metric most teams use to choose an inference API, and it is the right starting point and the wrong stopping point. This benchmark works through every layer of the voice stack — LLM, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and speech-to-speech — using figures verified against primary sources on August 30, 2026, with each number labeled as independently measured, vendor-published, or vendor-measured on its own product. The post Lowest-Latency Inference APIs for Voice and Realtime Agents: A Time to First Token TTFT-First Benchmark appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 語音代理的延遲問題遠早於其智慧水準的問題。首次令牌處理時間 (TTFT) 是大多數團隊選擇推理 API 時使用的指標，它雖然是正確的起點，但卻是錯誤的終點。此基準測試涵蓋了語音協定堆疊的每一層——LLM、語音轉文字、文字轉語音和語音轉語音——並使用截至 2026 年 8 月 30 日經原始資料來源驗證的數據，每個數據都標註為獨立測量、廠商發布或廠商在其自身產品上測量。本文《語音和即時代理的最低延遲推理 API：首次令牌處理時間 (TTFT) 基準測試》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Google AI Introduces EnvHarness: A Programmable Layer That Turns Static Agent Environments Into Adaptive Training Worlds
items_ai.summary: Google Cloud AI Research, with Washington University in St. Louis and UNC Chapel Hill, has released EnvHarness, an Apache-2.0 layer that turns a static agent benchmark into one that adapts to the policy training on it. It wraps a frozen environment through the standard reset()/step() interface, so tasks and human-built verifiers stay untouched — and an LLM designer, EnvRigger, writes those wrappers automatically against flaws diagnosed in the agent's own rollouts. Across five benchmarks, mined skills gain up to 9.0 points on held-out tasks with 9.8% fewer execution steps. The post Google AI Introduces EnvHarness: A Programmable Layer That Turns Static Agent Environments Into Adaptive Training Worlds appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google 雲端人工智慧研究中心與聖路易斯華盛頓大學和北卡羅來納大學教堂山分校合作，發布了 EnvHarness，這是一個 Apache 2.0 層，可以將靜態智能體基準測試轉換為能夠適應其策略訓練的自適應環境。它透過標準的 reset()/step() 介面封裝了一個凍結的環境，因此任務和人工建置的驗證器保持不變——LLM 的設計者 EnvRigger 會針對智能體自身部署中發現的缺陷自動編寫這些封裝器。在五個基準測試中，挖掘出的技能在保留的任務上最多可獲得 9.0 分的提升，同時執行步驟減少了 9.8%。這篇文章《Google AI 推出 EnvHarness：將靜態智能體環境轉化為自適應訓練環境的可程式層》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Understanding ChatGPT Work
items_ai.summary: OpenAI announced ChatGPT Work on July 9th, and have been furiously iterating on it ever since. It is an extraordinarily confusing and very powerful product. Here's what I've figured out about it so far. ChatGPT Work is actually two products The more interesting version of ChatGPT Work is the one that runs in the cloud. This can be accessed via chatgpt.com or through the ChatGPT mobile apps. Let's call it Work Cloud . If you install the ChatGPT desktop app - the app that used to be called Codex - you gain access to a thing called ChatGPT Work that can access files and run programs directly on your computer. Let's call that one Work Local . This one feels more like regular Codex re-skinned to be less intimidating to non-software-developers. For the rest of this article I'm going to talk exclusively about Work Cloud. Work is for paid subscribers only Right now, ChatGPT Work (in both flavors) is available only to $20/month and up subscribers. Free users and $8/month Go users do not have access. Work has features that aren't available in Chat The interface for accessing Work is a tab selector, which presents it as an alternative to Chat: The obvious question is when should I use Chat, and when should I use Work? OpenAI's official answer to that question is: Use Chat when you want an answer, explanation, brainstorm, or short draft. Use ChatGPT Work when you want ChatGPT to complete a task with a clear outcome, such as a brief, deck, analysis, recurring update, workflow, or file you can review and use. I find that almost entirely useless, because I've been using regular ChatGPT Ch
